title: Neutral MCP server config (ai/settings/settings.json's "mcp" key)
description: Synced by scripts/°base/ai/settings/sync.py into .mcp.json (Claude) and .codex/config.toml's [mcp_servers.*] tables (Codex).

tools.description: Named, reusable command-prefix snippets (e.g. wrapping a server with envmcp to load secrets from a .env file).

additionalProperties.description: Variants of one tool, keyed by variant name. The empty string key ("") is the default variant, selected by referencing the tool with no '@variant' suffix.

mode.description: How this snippet's `cmd` combines with the rest of the resolved command. Currently only 'prefix' (prepend to the argv) is implemented.

cmd.description: Argv tokens to prepend. May contain the literal token '$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)', substituted by sync.py itself (not a shell) with the absolute repo root.

servers.description: MCP server definitions, keyed by server name.

enabled.description: Whether this server is active. Rendered as Codex's native `enabled` field and (one-directionally) into Claude's enabledMcpjsonServers/disabledMcpjsonServers.

items.description: A reference to a tools.<name> entry, optionally '<name>@<variant>'. Resolved left-to-right; the leftmost tool is the outermost/first-spawned process.

cmd.description: The server's own bare command as one argv array (sync splits it into command/args for both clients).

anyOf.description: Enable-only override of a server defined elsewhere (e.g. .mcp.json); only rendered into Claude's enabledMcpjsonServers/disabledMcpjsonServers.
